effect_and_reconciliation_contract.dry_run_rule: Dry-run produces a redacted typed operation plan and predicted status transitions, does not access external approval contents beyond metadata validation, and proves the convergence state hash is unchanged.
effect_and_reconciliation_contract.effect_identity: request id plus canonical request hash plus initial convergence state hash plus fixed helper hash

operation_reconciliation.accept-baseline: Require exact approval/stage/repository/path scope and baseline event/hash changes; never advance again after a matching receipt.
operation_reconciliation.common: The helper atomically writes each mutation and a review_cycle_operation receipt keyed by request_id/operation_id with kind, input hash, prior status/hash identity, result code, and semantic result fields. Exact receipt/result is ALREADY_APPLIED; no receipt with the expected predecessor predicate is NOT_APPLIED; mismatched receipt or state predicate is INDETERMINATE.
operation_reconciliation.grant-autonomy/grant-scope-change: Require the exact state approval record and consumed external authority receipt bound to operation id.
operation_reconciliation.guard-baseline/check/status: Replay-safe observations; retain structured verdict/status receipts and perform no state mutation beyond the operation receipt.
operation_reconciliation.record-gap: Require the exact gap record once with its requirement/stage/evidence hashes.
operation_reconciliation.record-stage: Require the exact helper idempotency key, stage result content hash, and resulting state/status fields.
operation_reconciliation.transition: Require the exact allowed current-to-target transition and resulting outer-iteration/status effects; same target with matching receipt is already applied.

effect_and_reconciliation_contract.prepare: Persist the complete ordered operation plan, derived M/UnitBudget, expected per-operation state predicates, operation ids, external approval bindings, and final expected status before the first helper call.
effect_and_reconciliation_contract.resume_rule: Resume at the first operation without a matching semantic receipt. Never rerun an applied approval grant, baseline acceptance, stage record, or transition. Any predecessor or receipt disagreement stops the parent INDETERMINATE.

external_approval_contract.admission: The exact external approval receipt must exist and be unconsumed before an approval grant operation is prepared. Request text or this owner-contract approval is not authority to grant autonomy or expand scope.
external_approval_contract.consumption: Consume the external receipt atomically with the helper state approval record; identical replay by the same operation id is allowed.

operation_schemas.accept-baseline: Repository key already present in state, nonempty repository-relative changed paths, existing matching approval id, exact stage, and boolean approved-dirty-overlap mode.
operation_schemas.grant-autonomy: Exact grant id, repository keys, repository-relative allowed paths, stage, bounded evidence, and external authority_approval_receipt_id.
operation_schemas.grant-scope-change: Exact grant id, repository keys, repository-relative allowed paths, stage, bounded evidence, and external authority_approval_receipt_id.
operation_schemas.record-gap: Exact id, existing requirement_ids, exact source_stage, bounded impact, and bounded evidence fields.
operation_schemas.record-stage: A result file under task-artifact-root or runtime-temp validating against the helper stage-result schema.
operation_schemas.transition: A target in convergence_state.STATUSES that is allowed from the prepared current status.

parameter_contract.validation_boundary: Before budget reservation, validate the exact v2 request and operation field sets, unique operation ids, initial state hash/schema, fixed helper hash, repository keys/relative paths against state roots, requirement/stage/status references, result-file roots/schema, approval receipts, and the full simulated transition sequence. Reject legacy v1 requests for executable admission and reject caller helper or raw absolute repository/allowed paths.

terminal_contract.apply_success: cycle_status is APPLIED, not COMPLETE; operation_count equals M; final convergence_status exactly equals expected_final_status; final state request/operation receipt chain is complete; every external approval is correctly consumed; helper check passes; terminal artifact includes request/state/helper/budget/receipt hashes without unredacted evidence text.
common: The owner process return code is zero.
Every requested operation has exactly one matching semantic operation receipt in order.
A final structured helper check has verdict PASS and a final structured status object is schema-valid.
Exactly one owner_terminal event and matching terminal artifact exist for effect_id.
terminal_contract.dry_run_success: cycle_status is DRY_RUN; the redacted plan contains every operation plus final check/status; predicted final status equals expected_final_status; the state hash remains initial_state_sha256; no operation or external approval receipt was consumed.
source_corrections: Replace executable request-v1 with request-v2 carrying request/operation ids, initial state hash, and expected final convergence status.
Fix the helper path/hash and bind all state/request/result/repository paths to trusted roots and repository keys.
Require separate exact external approval receipts before grant-autonomy or grant-scope-change; request evidence alone cannot create authority.
Add atomic per-operation semantic receipts so crashes resume the first absent operation without duplicating grants, baseline accepts, stages, or transitions.
Parse and validate final helper check/status, report cycle_status APPLIED separately from convergence_status, and terminalize exactly once instead of trusting exit zero and a fixed pass string.

trusted_roots.authority-approval-store: The durable external approval store for autonomy and scope-change grants
trusted_roots.repository-root-registry: The repository identities already materialized and content-addressed in the selected convergence state

apply.derivation: Seven required research/terminal tasks, one sixty-minute task per ordered helper mutation/observation, one final check task, and one final status task.

variables.M: The exact nonzero operation count in the fully materialized request.

unit_budget.reservation_rule: Materialize and hash the complete request, compute numeric M, and reserve every ordered operation plus final check/status before the first mutation. Callers cannot supply M or a budget; retries remain within each operation's sixty-minute cap.
